# MrScraper

MrScraper provides web scraping APIs for structured extraction, search results, marketplace data, travel data, and web unblocking.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mrscraper/.

## Actions

- **Bulk Rerun AI Scraper**: Run an existing General AI scraper configuration against multiple URLs in one request.
- **Bulk Rerun Manual Scraper**: Run an existing saved manual scraper workflow against multiple URLs in one request.
- **Create AI Scraper**: Create and run a general, listing, or map AI scraper against a website.
- **Get Account Usage** (read-only): Return the connected MrScraper account's plan, token usage, concurrency allowance, and rate limits without exposing user identity or token…
- **Get Scrape Analytics Timeline** (read-only): Return time-series scrape activity and success metrics for a domain and action over a time range.
- **Get Scrape Result** (read-only): Retrieve the current status and output for one accessible scrape result by ID.
- **Get Scrape Status Analytics** (read-only): Return aggregate scrape counts, success rate, request rate, latency, and status totals for a domain and action over a time range.
- **Heal Manual Scraper**: Ask MrScraper to repair an existing manual scraper workflow that no longer matches its target site.
- **List Scrape Results** (read-only): List scrape results for the connected account with filtering, sorting, and agent-controlled pagination.
- **Rerun AI Scraper**: Run an existing AI scraper configuration against a new URL, with optional map crawl controls.
- **Rerun Manual Scraper**: Run an existing saved manual scraper workflow against a new URL.
